g.text: Who has a website to check

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: 'Confirmed' mostly means 'has a website': 80% of claims confirmed with one, 2.5% without,

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and only 18% of public records have one the crawl could check (private 51%)

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Claims: dataset sentences naming the service (kb/taxonomy lexicon, non-offer, negated, other-facility, staff and directory lines removed). Second checks: the facility's own

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: website (quote-verified, kb/web_evidence; quotes confirming a claim were right 21 of 22 times), OSM emergency=yes, the MoHFW trauma care list, NHSRC LaQshya. Website = an

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: attributable own site or branch page in the crawl. A facility without a website cannot be confirmed here, so an unconfirmed claim is missing evidence, not evidence against.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: 1,883 of 2,059 website confirmations come from a site already in the record's own source list: a re-check of the source, not an independent witness. The crawl skipped

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: government portals by design, which lowers public coverage.
